changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, code, description) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, 'admin.titles.review', 'Verify or reject the land titles developers declare, and record an estate''s due-diligence checks.'); INSERT INTO role_permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, role_id, permission_id) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, r.id, p.id FROM roles r, permissions p WHERE r.code = 'super_admin' AND p.code = 'admin.titles.review';

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: DROP VIEW marketplace_listings; CREATE VIEW marketplace_listings WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT e.id AS estate_id, e.name AS name, e.area AS area, e.city AS city, e.state AS state, e.description AS description, e.intent AS intent, e.corner_premium_pct AS corner_premium_pct, e.published_at AS published_at, e.footprint AS footprint, t.title_type AS title_type, t.status AS title_status, CASE WHEN t.status = 'VERIFIED' THEN t.decided_at END AS title_verified_at, b.name AS branch_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.trading_name), ''), o.registered_name) AS company_name, v.last_verified_at AS last_verified_at, ft.price AS from_price, ft.currency AS from_price_currency, ft.price_per_sqm AS from_price_per_sqm, sz.min_size_sqm AS min_size_sqm, sz.max_size_sqm AS max_size_sqm, COALESCE(pr.plots_remaining, 0) AS plots_remaining, b.street AS branch_street, b.city AS branch_city, b.state AS branch_state, b.phone AS branch_phone, b.email AS branch_email, cv.file_id AS cover_file_id FROM marketplace_estate_eligibility el JOIN estates e ON e.id = el.estate_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = e.branch_id AND b.deleted = false LEFT JOIN estate_titles t ON t.estate_id = e.id AND t.deleted = false LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT max(c.last_verified_at) AS last_verified_at FROM estate_verification_checks c WHERE c.estate_id = e.id AND c.deleted = false AND c.status = 'VERIFIED' ) v ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pt.price, pt.currency, CASE WHEN pt.tier_type = 'LAND_SIZE' AND pt.size_sqm > 0 THEN round(pt.price / pt.size_sqm, 2) END AS price_per_sqm FROM price_tiers pt WHERE pt.estate_id = e.id AND pt.deleted = false ORDER BY EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM plots p WHERE p.price_tier_id = pt.id AND p.deleted = false AND p.status IN ('AVAILABLE_DEV', 'AVAILABLE_INV') ) DESC, pt.price ASC LIMIT 1 ) ft ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(pt.size_sqm) AS min_size_sqm, max(pt.size_sqm) AS max_size_sqm FROM price_tiers pt WHERE pt.estate_id = e.id AND pt.deleted = false AND pt.tier_type = 'LAND_SIZE' ) sz ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS plots_remaining FROM plots p WHERE p.estate_id = e.id AND p.deleted = false AND p.status IN ('AVAILABLE_DEV', 'AVAILABLE_INV') ) pr ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ph.file_id FROM estate_photos ph JOIN stored_files f ON f.id = ph.file_id WHERE ph.estate_id = e.id AND ph.deleted = false AND ph.cover AND f.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND f.status = 'READY' ) cv ON true WHERE el.eligible; REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_listings FROM ${appDbUsername}; GRANT SELECT ON marketplace_listings TO ${appDbUsername};
